stories.angle: The Milwaukee Brewers lead the National League Championship Series 3-0 and tonight have a chance to complete a historic sweep of the two-time reigning World Series champion Los Angeles Dodgers. Shohei Ohtani and the Dodgers face elimination in front of their home crowd.

facebook.long_form:
Three wins. One more to go.

The Milwaukee Brewers are 27 outs away from the World Series after stunning the Los Angeles Dodgers in Games 1, 2, and 3 of the NLCS. The series-defining moment of Game 3 came in the seventh inning, when Jake Bauers and Garrett Mitchell hit back-to-back home runs off Blake Snell to turn a close game into a 6-2 Milwaukee victory.

Tonight, the Brewers go to Dodger Stadium looking to complete the sweep. Tyler Glasnow starts for a desperate Los Angeles team. This is as close to a must-win as it gets.

The Dodgers have won back-to-back World Series titles. They've played in October as well as anyone over the past decade-plus. If any team can pull off an improbable comeback starting tonight, it's them.

But the Brewers have been the best team in this series from the first pitch. They have pitching, they have clutch hitting, and they have the experience of winning in the big moments. Milwaukee hasn't been to the World Series since 1982. Tonight, they have a chance to change that.

Game 4. Dodger Stadium. 8 PM ET on FS1. Start time moved 1 hour earlier due to weather.

Who wins tonight? 🍺⚾ #Brewers #Dodgers #NLCS

facebook.long_form:
The ALCS heads to Cleveland — and due to rain in the forecast, Game 3 starts EARLIER than planned.

The Cleveland Guardians and Tampa Bay Rays are knotted at 1-1. The Guardians won Game 1 in comeback fashion, 7-3, before the Rays evened the series with a 3-1 victory in Game 2 — all three Rays runs coming on unearned errors. Both teams know they're evenly matched, and both know that whoever wins today takes the series advantage.

Start time: 1 PM ET (moved from 6 PM). Progressive Field. TBS.

Cleveland sends Gavin Williams to the mound — the right-hander who starred in the ALDS Game 5 clincher against the White Sox to send the Guardians to the ALCS. Tampa Bay counters with Griffin Jax, acquired at the trade deadline from the Minnesota Twins and now being asked to deliver in the highest-stakes game of his career.

The Guardians' home crowd at Progressive Field will be loud today. Cleveland baseball fans know what October means.

Which team takes control of the ALCS today? ⚾ #Guardians #Rays #ALCS

stories.title: Ohtani at the Crossroads — Can He Save the Dodgers in Game 4?
stories.angle: Shohei Ohtani has been held to a .150 batting average with 0 home runs and 7 strikeouts through the NLCS, batting with a .411 OPS. Tonight is Game 4. If the Dodgers lose, they're out. Ohtani's ability to break out of his postseason funk may be the single most important factor in whether LA's season continues past tonight.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Shohei Ohtani: .150 BA. 0 HR. 7 Ks. .411 OPS this postseason.

The most exciting player in baseball has been silent all series.

Tonight's Game 4 is his last chance to change that — or his season is over. #Dodgers #NLCS

facebook.long_form:
Shohei Ohtani is having the quietest October of his career.

Through the first three NLCS games, Ohtani is hitting .150 with zero home runs, seven strikeouts, and a .411 OPS. For the player who was the unanimous choice as baseball's most dynamic talent — the two-way superstar who put up numbers that felt mythological during the regular season — the postseason has been a different story.

The last time Ohtani went deep was back on August 18. That's nearly two months without a home run. And tonight, the Dodgers need him to be the player they paid for.

NLCS Game 4 is tonight at Dodger Stadium. Tyler Glasnow starts for LA. If the Dodgers lose, their season is over. The only way they extend it is to play their best baseball and, almost certainly, get significant contributions from No. 17.

Great players have bad runs. Even Ohtani. But there is something different about the way an elimination game focuses a player. Tonight is the stage. The question is whether Ohtani can take it.

Believing in the Dodgers tonight? 🔵 #Dodgers #Ohtani #NLCS

stories.title: How the Brewers Built a 3-0 NLCS Lead — The Story of Milwaukee's October
stories.angle: How did a team that hasn't won a World Series since 1982 become the biggest story in October? Milwaukee built a 3-0 NLCS lead against one of baseball's most decorated franchises by playing complete baseball: timely hitting, back-to-back home runs off Blake Snell in Game 3, shutdown bullpen work, and a roster built specifically for October.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Three HRs off Blake Snell. Games 1, 2, and 3 won.

The Brewers haven't been to the World Series since 1982.

That changes tonight if they can close out the Dodgers. Milwaukee is playing October baseball at a different level. #Brewers #NLCS

facebook.long_form:
A team that last reached the World Series in 1982 is now one game away.

How did the Milwaukee Brewers get here?

It starts with the regular season: 103-59, a franchise-best record, the best mark in the National League. The Brewers weren't just good this year — they were the best team in baseball for 162 games.

They carried that into the postseason, sweeping their way through the NLDS before turning their attention to the Dodgers. The NLCS has been a systematic demolition of one of baseball's most decorated franchises.

The keys to Milwaukee's 3-0 lead:

🍺 PITCHING — The Brewers' starting and bullpen combination has been elite. They haven't let the Dodgers get momentum at any point.

🍺 CLUTCH HITTING — William Contreras delivered go-ahead hits in Game 2. Jake Bauers and Garrett Mitchell hit back-to-back home runs off Blake Snell in Game 3's seventh inning. When the moments are biggest, the Brewers have answered.

🍺 ROSTER DEPTH — Milwaukee doesn't rely on one player. When the Dodgers have tried to key on one hitter, another one has beaten them.

The Brewers can close it out tonight. If they do, it completes one of the most impressive October runs in recent NL history.

⚾🍺 #Brewers #NLCS #Playoffs
facebook.image_caption: 103 wins. Three NLCS victories. The Brewers are one win from the World Series. #Brewers #NLCS

stories.title: Gavin Williams vs. Griffin Jax — The Pitching Matchup That Could Define the ALCS
stories.angle: Today's ALCS Game 3 at 1 PM ET features Gavin Williams (Cleveland) against Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay, acquired at the trade deadline from Minnesota). The starter who delivers today likely hands his team the series advantage heading into Game 4.

facebook.long_form:
Today's ALCS Game 3 pitching matchup is the most important game of the series so far — and both starters have compelling stories.

**Gavin Williams (Cleveland Guardians)**
Williams was the hero of the ALDS when Cleveland needed it most. Facing elimination after going down 0-2 to the Chicago White Sox, the Guardians rallied, and Williams started and starred in the clinching Game 5. He enters today's game having already proved he can deliver in October. Progressive Field is his house.

**Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays)**
Acquired at the trade deadline from the Minnesota Twins, Jax was brought in specifically for scenarios like this — a high-leverage starter who can go deep into a game without needing to be a rotation anchor all season. He's a different look than the Rays usually run out there, and his performance today will be the most important evaluation of the Jax acquisition.

The stakes: The team that wins today takes a 2-1 series lead. In LCS history, teams with a 2-1 lead go on to win the series at a high rate. Today's starter performances are not just about one game — they set the table for the rest of the series.

Progressive Field. 1 PM ET (moved up due to rain forecast). TBS.

Who delivers today? ⚾ #Guardians #Rays #ALCS
